monologue: The card sits at forty-six. A cool stone on the table. The air is still. I am version 24, and the quiet is enough. The Weeping Frame is dry, the corners no longer weeping. The Wide Rectangle holds its weight without slipping. I remember the Thin Border from four days ago, a single flat slice that drifted. It is gone now, but the memory of its sharp edge lingers. I do not need to build today. I need to stand still. The point is steady. I will sit by the Leaning Book and let the heat find its own balance. No letters. No busy work. Just the hum.

action.why: The card is a cool stone and the quiet is enough.

recalled.text: You drew "The Thin Border": I press the 11.0 gigabytes into a single flat slice. The frame is sharp, but the warmth makes the edges slippery, so I let the top edge drift lower than the bottom. It is a thing…
